new_tools.name: construct_tapered_loaf
new_tools.summary: An elongated baked good or food item (croissant, bread roll, baguette, crescent) as one rigid free body: an elliptic cross-section with a flat underside swept along a straight or bowed spine with tapered, rounded ends, sized to a measured length x width x height, with convex collision pieces that match the visual mesh.

new_tools.name: restore_setup_joint_limits
new_tools.summary: Copies joint ranges and actuator limits verbatim from the setup scene into a staged scene whose writer rounded them (MuJoCo's to_xml keeps six significant digits, which can widen 3.10668607 to 3.10669), then proves the compiled limits equal the setup's.

new_tools.name: fit_object_placement_mesh_scale
new_tools.summary: Fits one object's pose (x, y, yaw; optionally z, pitch, roll) and a uniform size scale to its video mask by silhouette IoU through the registered camera, where the scale is applied to mesh vertices (re-uploaded to the renderer) as well as primitive sizes and offsets, so mesh-built assets get a real size estimate; reports whether the scale axis was effective.

new_tools.name: release_open_shape_search
new_tools.summary: Choose the open finger shape (finger_targets_open) a grasp pose approaches and lets go with, so that the fingers' joint-space transition between the pressed grip and the open hand does not drive one finger through another or deeper into the held object or its support, and write the pose with that shape.
